title: Propaganda – Truth 100ml
description:
Propaganda – Truth 100ml
Get your summer vibes going with Propaganda Truth e-juice. A delicious Tart base with a mixed berry to give you a fruity sensation, couple this with sweet undertones of lemonade. If summer fruity e-liquids are your go-to juice then Propaganda will not disappoint!  Take me back to the sweet times and sweet tunes, relax, chill out and savor this pure sweet delicious e-juice. Made to make your mouth water.
Truth by Propaganda vape juice has a very unique blend of Mixed Berry Tart and Lemonade all mixed together in a single E-Liquid bottle.
